info.title: dotnet polhem - Polhem framework CLI
info.description: Polhem framework CLI, a dotnet tool invoked as `dotnet polhem`. Writes out and lists the default definition files embedded in Polhem.Definition, produces the encrypted key values SystemSettings.xml stores, and turns Excel workbooks that describe forms into definition files.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the relative paths of all embedded defaults

commands.name: materialize
commands.description: Write embedded framework defaults to a target directory

options.name: --path
options.description: Target directory (created if missing). Required.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Overwrite existing files. Default: skip (preserves consumer customisations).

options.name: --filter
options.description:
Only materialize files whose relative path starts with this prefix.
e.g. --filter TableSchema/ to write only schema files.

options.name: --help
options.description: Print this help text.

commands.name: forms
commands.description: Describe forms in Excel workbooks and import them (template / export / import)

commands.name: export
commands.description: Write the workbook of an existing form

options.name: --define
options.description: The definition folder that holds FormSchema/. Required.

options.name: --out
options.description: The workbook to write. Default: <ProgId>.xlsx

options.name: --lang
options.description: The language of the headers and instructions: en or zh-TW. Default: en

options.name: --help
options.description: Print this help text.

commands.name: import
commands.description: Turn a workbook into FormSchema, TableSchema, FormLayout and registrations

options.name: --define
options.description: The definition folder to write to. Required.

options.name: --tables
options.description:
What to do with an existing TableSchema:
merge      add the columns and indexes the form brings (default)
keep       leave it as it is
overwrite  replace it with the one generated from the form

options.name: --regenerate-layout
options.description: Replace an existing FormLayout. Default: keep it (it may be hand-tuned).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: List the files that would change without writing them.

options.name: --help
options.description: Print this help text.

commands.name: template
commands.description: Write an empty workbook for describing a new form

options.name: --out
options.description: The workbook to write. Required.

options.name: --lang
options.description: The language of the headers and instructions: en or zh-TW. Default: en

options.name: --help
options.description: Print this help text.

commands.name: keys
commands.description: Produce encrypted key values for SystemSettings.xml (protect)

commands.name: protect
commands.description: Generate a new key and print it encrypted with the master key

options.name: --master-key-env
options.description:
Read the master key from this environment variable.
Default: POLHEM_MASTER_KEY.

options.name: --master-key-file
options.description: Read the master key from this file instead.

options.name: --help
options.description: Print this help text.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this help text
Run 'dotnet polhem help <command>' for command-specific help.
